standard-sole-purpose.heading: Use of Confidential Information
paragraphs: The Receiving Party shall use the Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and for no other purpose whatsoever, and shall not use it to the detriment of the Disclosing Party.

standard-restricted-use.heading: Permitted Purpose
paragraphs: The Receiving Party may use the Confidential Information only to the extent necessary for the Purpose.

The Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer, decompile or analyse the composition of any sample, prototype or software included in the Confidential Information, except as the Purpose strictly requires.
